title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Microsoft Fabric and Power BI risk indicators
notes: claim 68: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, administrator controls, permissions, default state and pay-as-you-go requirements are supported. One descriptive statement needs narrowing: Microsoft does not establish that monitored Fabric activity is the only wider effect of the change.

claims.claim: Add-RoleGroupMember -Identity "Insider Risk Management" -Member "<user-UPN>" adds a user to the role group and grants its effective permissions.
claims.quote:
Use the Add-RoleGroupMember cmdlet to add members to a management role group.
The Identity parameter specifies the role group to add a member to.
The Member parameter specifies who you want to add to the role group.
User ID or user principal name (UPN)
